title: Philip K. Dick's 1974 dream precognizing Close Encounters of the Third Kind

tellings.quote: he was he was shown a a a a brownie I think or or that that had been scored by a fork around around its edges and it was somehow a relief map

plain: In a 1974 dream, the science fiction writer Philip K. Dick was shown what looked like a brownie scored around its edges with a fork, which was 'somehow a relief map.' The writer Eric Wargo, who studies dreams that seem to foresee the future, tells this on the show from Dick's letters. He reads the dream as an early glimpse of Steven Spielberg's 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind. If so, a dream would have caught an image from a film that did not yet exist.
